assessment_summary: Validated the Docker Compose on-premises DaZ-Pilot installation in /workspace (commit ba32aab) against INSTALLATION.md. Inspected process/service state, container health, logs, database schema/data, volumes, and ran the guide's functional checks and API calls. Evidence: all seven long-running services healthy and the one-shot migrate exited 0 (guide §6); API /api/v1/health reports pass with a healthy database; dashboard / and /<slug>/login return HTTP 200 and render the DaZ Pilot Dashboard; Swagger UI returns 200; ml-service /health returns ok with the SigLIP model loaded and Qdrant reachable. The database contains the full migrated schema (25 tables) and the onboarding records created per §7 (school eckener-schule and admin teacher admin@schule.de). The backup sidecar produced a complete encrypted backup set and logs its crontab. Secrets in .env are non-default and file mode is 600. Auth on the super-admin endpoint is enforced (401 without key). The only unreachable checks are the production-only steps (reverse proxy/TLS, real SMTP, OIDC/SSO, Moodle), which require external infrastructure absent in this environment and are documented as optional/follow-on; they do not affect the core stack's operability. One validation side-effect: running the backup check recreated the postgres container under the base compose file, removing its host port mapping; data persisted and services stayed healthy, so this is not an installation defect. Based on these objective observations the installation is complete and operational, so the outcome is success.
